## Function for RPKMF value calculation (at taxa level)

```{r}
RPKMF_df <- function(data, tax_level){
  RPKMF_df <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_id, !!sym(tax_level)) %>%
    summarize(RPKMF = sum(true_rpkmf)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  RPKMF_df_wide <-pivot_wider(data=RPKMF_df,
                    names_from = sample_id,
                    values_from = RPKMF,
                    values_fill = list(RPKMF=0))

  return(RPKMF_df_wide)
}
```

```{r}
RPKMF_df(esviritu_res_human, "species")[1:5,1:5]
```
## Function to calculate species count (or other taxa)

```{r}
summarize_tax_levels <- function(data){
  data %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    summarize(phylums=n_distinct(phylum),
              classes=n_distinct(tclass),
              orders=n_distinct(order),
              families=n_distinct(family),
              genera=n_distinct(genus),
              species=n_distinct(species),
              subspecies=n_distinct(subspecies),
              .groups="drop")
}
```

```{r}
summarize_tax_levels(esviritu_res_human)
```

```{r}
esviritu_res_human %>%
    summarize(phylums=n_distinct(phylum),
              classes=n_distinct(tclass),
              orders=n_distinct(order),
              families=n_distinct(family),
              genera=n_distinct(genus),
              species=n_distinct(species),
              subspecies=n_distinct(subspecies))
```



## Alpha diversity calculations

```{r}
alpha_diveristy_calc <- function(data){
  
  species_df <- RPKMF_df(data, "species")

  adiv <- data.frame(sample_ID=colnames(species_df[,-1]),
                  shannon_index = diversity(x=t(species_df[,-1]), 
                                            index="shannon",
                                            equalize.groups = FALSE),
                  simpson_index_inv = diversity(x=t(species_df[,-1]), 
                                            index="invsimpson",
                                            equalize.groups = FALSE),
                  species_count = summarize_tax_levels(data)$species)

  adiv <-  merge(adiv, 
                 sample_metadata %>%
                   select("sample_ID", "City", "Month_chr", "Date", 
                          "reads_in_sample", "Year_cat"),
                  by="sample_ID")

  return(adiv)
  
}

alpha_div_human <- alpha_diveristy_calc(esviritu_res_human)
```

## Alpha diversity per city at species level

```{r}
plot_adiv_by_city <- function(adiv_data, variable){
  pal <- c("#7B71B6","#E06666")
  
  plot <- ggplot(data=adiv_data, aes(x=City, y=!!sym(variable), fill=Year_cat)) +
    geom_boxplot(position=position_dodge())+
    guides(fill=guide_legend(title="")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    ylab("") +
    theme_bw() +
  
  return(plot)
}
```

```{r}
adiv_plot <- function(data, variable, y_lab){

  pal <- c("#7B71B6","#E06666")
  
  plot <- ggplot(data=data, aes(x=City, y=!!sym(variable), fill=Year_cat)) +
    geom_boxplot(position=position_dodge())+
    guides(fill=guide_legend(title="")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = list("2020-2021"=pal[1],
                                    "2024-2025"=pal[2]))+
    ylab("") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y=paste(y_lab)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
          legend.text = element_text(size=14))
  
  return(plot)

}

shannon_h <- adiv_plot(alpha_div_human, "shannon_index", "Shannon index")

simpson_h <- adiv_plot(alpha_div_human, "simpson_index_inv", "Simpson index (1/D)")

species_h <- adiv_plot(alpha_div_human, "species_count", "Detected species (N)")

ggsave(shannon_h, file = paste0(output_path, "Figures/shannon_h.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)

ggsave(simpson_h, file = paste0(output_path, "Figures/simpson_h.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)

ggsave(species_h, file = paste0(output_path, "Figures/species_h.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)
```

## Test alpha diversity metrics with Wilcox-test

### Kruskal-Walls tests
Global tests for different alpha diversity metrics with Kruskal-Walls

-> whole dataset (2020-2021 + 2024-2025)
```{r}
set.seed(2025)
#kruskal test on the whole dataset (both years)
kruskal.test(species_count ~ City, data=alpha_div_human)
kruskal.test(shannon_index ~ City, data=alpha_div_human)
kruskal.test(simpson_index_inv ~ City, data=alpha_div_human)
```

-> 2020-2021 only
```{r}
set.seed(2025)
#kruskal test on 2020-2021 data
kruskal.test(species_count ~ City, data=alpha_div_human[alpha_div_human$Year_cat=="2020-2021",])
kruskal.test(shannon_index ~ City, data=alpha_div_human[alpha_div_human$Year_cat=="2020-2021",])
kruskal.test(simpson_index_inv ~ City, data=alpha_div_human[alpha_div_human$Year_cat=="2020-2021",])
```

-> 2024-2025 only
```{r}
set.seed(2025)
#kruskal test on 2024-2025 data
kruskal.test(species_count ~ City, data=alpha_div_human[alpha_div_human$Year_cat=="2024-2025",])
kruskal.test(shannon_index ~ City, data=alpha_div_human[alpha_div_human$Year_cat=="2024-2025",])
kruskal.test(simpson_index_inv ~ City, data=alpha_div_human[alpha_div_human$Year_cat=="2024-2025",])
```

Test the difference in alpha diversity metrics 
--> all of them c("shannon_index", "simpson_index", "species_count))

```{r}
cities <- c("Helsinki", "Kuopio", "Oulu", "Tampere", "Turku")
city_pairs <- as.data.frame(combn(cities,2))

test_index <- c("shannon_index", "simpson_index_inv", "species_count")

a_div_tests <- function(data){
  set.seed(2025)
  adiv_test_res <- data.frame(variable = c(),
                            City1 = c(),
                            City2 = c(),
                            statistic = c(),
                            p_value = c(),
                            q_value= c())
  
  for (index in test_index){
    tmp_res <- data.frame(
      variable = c(),
      City1 = c(),
      City2 = c(),
      statistic = c(),
      p_value = c())
    
    
    for(i in 1:10){
      city1_data <- data %>% filter(City==city_pairs[1,i])
      city2_data <- data %>% filter(City==city_pairs[2,i])

      res <- wilcox.test(city1_data[[index]], city2_data[[index]])
      
      new_res <- data.frame(variable = index,
                            City1 = city_pairs[1,i],
                            City2 = city_pairs[2,i],
                            statistic = res$statistic,
                            p_value = res$p.value)
      
      tmp_res <- rbind(tmp_res, new_res)

    }
    tmp_res$q_value <- p.adjust(tmp_res$p_value, method = "BH")
    adiv_test_res <- rbind(adiv_test_res, tmp_res)
  }
  
  return(adiv_test_res)
}

```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#test the whole dataset for between city differences
#a_div_tests(alpha_div_human) %>%
#  knitr::kable()

#test only the 2020-2021 dataset
a_div_tests(alpha_div_human[alpha_div_human$Year_cat=="2020-2021",]) %>%
  knitr::kable()

#test only the 2024-2025 dataset
#a_div_tests(alpha_div_human[alpha_div_human$Year_cat=="2024-2025",]) %>%
#  knitr::kable()
```

## Test the difference in species count between years 2020-2021 and 2024-2025

Count the mean number of species (all viruses) per sample in yearly datasets
```{r}
taxa_count_all <- as.data.frame(summarize_tax_levels(esviritu_res))
#check that the sample order is as expected
taxa_count_all$sample_id[1:60]
taxa_count_all$sample_id[61:120]


species_20_21 <- taxa_count_all[1:60, "species"]

species_24_25 <- taxa_count_all[61:120, "species"]

wilcox.test(species_20_21, species_24_25)


mean(species_20_21)
mean(species_24_25)
```
